reading:
Pocket Diary has been judged for its type system above all. Every judge since tour round 2 praised the same things: the diary's date stack (a big light figure with the mono month over the weekday) held on Home, Plans, To do and Chat; the Now/Next/Later spine as the clearest page structure on any panel; Plans as diary weeks beside a month on a little glass ("the lineage's best page"); To do's inline "What needs doing… Add"; and amber kept to late. It peaked at 8.03 (t2-pocket-graft) and settled at 7.31-7.55 as Kept. Its own mutant (t3-pocket-mut, Lit) scored 7.04, with 4 promise votes for one rule: "the machine speaks in light, the family writes matte".

What sank Kept on the landing panel:
- **Too faint and too fussy.** The spine is a thin dim line with small square nodes and tracked mono pill plates (Now, Next, Someday), so it does not lead the eye (feedback, soul, style, system, skeptic, type).
- **Too dark and empty.** Much of the page is void, with little grounded solid colour. The right column empties below the wishes, and a dotted Later tail runs into nothing (feedback, system, skeptic).
- **Heavy setup.** The full setup list takes a whole column (skeptic, interaction).
- **The tube costs height.** Coming up falls below the fold (interaction).
- **Small things:** amber-outlined checkboxes read as warnings, small grey meta text, a redundant "2 Oct Fri" stamp over the greeting, and a phone bar that shows the secondary pages.
- **Little light.** In phosphor terms it changed little from its parent: the tube and the box glow, and almost nothing else.

What would make it win: keep the diary's typesetting and the time spine exactly as the system, and make the line itself the bold thing (heavier steel, rings with lamps at the stops, labels as words). Put light only where the machine is live or speaking, in instruments that carry data, which is where the other camp is strongest. Desk Terminal's needle meter and its tube warming up from a line are the round's best period instruments. Quote Board has the one row afterglow that registers and the one-line setup. Evening Listing has the lit chain. Then fill the void with grounded slate solids that have a job. Its own mutant's lit-voice rule answers the owner's latest word ("bring some of that back") without glare.

briefs.name: Pocket Diary, Lit Line
briefs.hypothesis: Kept lost on faintness, fussiness and void, never on its idea or its type: every lens kept the diary date stack and the Now/Next/Later spine. This cross keeps both untouched as the system and fixes what was faulted. The spine becomes heavier, with rings and lamps, and its labels become words. The page is filled with grounded slate solids that have a job. Setup shrinks to one line, so the right column and the fold come back. The light arrives as the other camp's best instruments, rebuilt on the diary's own line: Desk Terminal's moving-coil spend needle and its tube warming up from a line, Quote Board's visible row afterglow and its one-line setup, and Evening Listing's chain lit only between lamps that are on. The light obeys one rule taken from the line's own mutant: what the machine says and reads out glows, and what the family writes stays matte. That gives the owner the original's light back where attention belongs (the Now lamp, the lit word, the tube, the needle, Vera's newest line) on a calmer, more structured page than the carried design.
briefs.brief:
Start from t3-pocket-refine's files (x14a-b/palettes/t3-pocket-refine.json, x14a-b/variants/t3-pocket-refine/sheet.css and templates/). Keep the slate tokens, the Plex Sans / Instrument Sans (condensed 600 heads) / Plex Mono split, VT323 on glass only, the diary date stack, the Plans diary weeks beside the month glass, To do's quick add, and the bar.

THE LINE (every page). The spine `--steel` becomes 2px at #5b6973 (from 1px #4b5963), one weight everywhere, with no dashed runs.
- Nodes: replace every square node with one ring style, a 10px hollow ring (border 2px `--steel-2`, fill `--bg`).
- Now: a 12px ring filled #6dff9c with the kit's E20 two-layer lamp halo (0 0 6px and 0 0 18px of the brand at .55/.22). Next: a sage `--lit` ring that breathes (E20 breathe, 3.2s). Late: an amber ring. Section heads: plain hollow rings.
- Squares now mean only 'a box you tick'.
- Labels: the `.plate` pills (Now, Next, Later, Someday) go. Each stop's label is a word set beside its ring in Instrument Sans 600, 0.875rem, sentence case, no box, no tracking. Now is in `--brand` with a small E1 halo (0 0 .35em at .45), Next in `--lit`, Later and No date in `--label`.
- The line ends at the last row it serves. No dotted tail runs into empty space anywhere.

HOME, 1280. Two columns: the spine's main column (max 47rem) and the shelf (24rem) on its own hairline.
(1) Now. The '2 Oct Fri' stamp above the box goes. Today's diary stack moves into Vera's tab beside her screen: 'Vera · 2 Oct Fri', the 2 at 1.5rem Plex Sans Light tabular in `--brand` with E1 halo, the month in `--plans` and the weekday in `--label`, both 0.75rem mono stacked.
- The title is 'What can we *pencil* in?': Instrument Sans 600 condensed, 2.75rem, `--heading` bone. 'pencil' is in #6dff9c with the full E1 layered halo, and the box stays lit from below through scanlines (E7, E14).
- No caret or cursor in the placeholder.
(2) Setup stop. Directly under the starters, a stop on the spine with an amber ring, one line, max 64px tall: an amber warning icon and 'Finish setting up' in `--people` 600 0.9375rem, then the figure '3' in condensed 1.75rem `--heading` (bone, not amber), then the first step as the one link in bold, 'Choose your own password', with ', then Telegram and Calendar' run in after it in `--ink-2`. At the right, a quiet `details` 'All 3 steps' opens the numbered list in place.
(3) Next. The tube shortens to at most 13.5rem (216px) overall. The four-week trace with its weekend bands moves inside the glass as its bottom band, 3rem tall. The radar shrinks to 6rem at the top right of the glass. The '› 3 more on the radar' line stays.
- The tube warms up from a bright line once as the page opens.
- Coming up must start above the 900px fold.
(4) Coming up. Each diary row sits on a grounded day tab: the date stack in a solid 4rem slate cell (`--leaf` #182024, 2px radius, 1px `--leaf-edge` top highlight) like a diary's thumb tab. The figure is 2rem Plex Sans Light tabular in `--heading`, the month in `--plans` at full strength and the weekday in `--label`.
- Then the time in Plex Mono `--ink-2`, the title in Plex Sans 500 1rem `--ink`, and the relative words 'in 7 days' right-aligned as a dim phosphor readout (Plex Mono, `--lit` at 80%, text-shadow 0 0 6px brand at .22), because the machine reads it out.
- Row height 3.25rem.
(5) Later: Lately added. Cap the rows at a 44rem measure. Each kind's icon sits in a 1.75rem solid slate well (`--surface-3`) tinted 14% toward its kind ink, with the icon in the kind ink. 'for Maya, Theo' follows the kind word in `--ink-2`, and #n sits at the row's right edge in mono `--faint`. Close the 450px gap.
THE SHELF (right): the freed column, now To do first, then the kids' wishes, then Something to eat.
- Each group is a solid slate leaf (`--leaf`, 1px `--leaf-edge`, 1rem 1.25rem padding), hung from the shelf line at a hollow ring, with its head Instrument Sans 600 1.25rem and the count in Plex Mono tabular.
- To do's checkboxes are neutral (1.5px `--steel-2`), with a 44px hit area (L198 technique). Amber only on the ring for late rows and on the 'was due' words, which are Plex Sans, not mono.
- 'who' sits in a fixed 6.5rem column in `--label`.
- The NOW divider is a 1px lit rule (brand at .6 with a 6px glow) that runs from a Now ring.
AFTERGLOW. Every row (diary rows, shelf rows, Ideas rows, Status rows, Settings rows) lights at once on hover and on `:has(:focus-visible)`: background `--row-wash` (#9cc4dc 10% over `--surface`) and box-shadow inset 2px 0 0 `--lit`, 0 0 18px -10px `--lit`. Transition-duration `--glow-in` (.12s) to come on and `--afterglow` 1.4s cubic-bezier(.25,.45,.35,1) to decay. The edge is always sage, never full brand.

CHAT. The rule 'the machine speaks in light, the family writes matte':
- Vera's lines are small screens: dark glass `--phosphor-glass`, a 1px phosphor rim at .45, and her words in pale phosphor #cdeedb with only 0 0 6px brand at .25, so 16px stays crisp.
- Only her newest line keeps a bloom (0 0 28px -8px brand at .5). When the page lands on #latest it flashes and fades over 1.8s (keyframes `arrived`), guarded by prefers-reduced-motion.
- Older lines keep the rim only.
- The family's slips are matte slate (#1c2530) with a 2px `--accent` left edge and `--ink` words.
- All times hang in one right-aligned tabular margin left of the spine. The day stop is the diary stack.

PLANS. Keep it as it is.
- The month glass's day cells grow to at least 2.5rem (40px), and each day with a plan is a link to its row on the agenda (`#d-YYYY-MM-DD`, with the row's `:target` doing a landed flash).
- The glass warms up from a line.
- Week heads ('5 Oct – 11 Oct') are Plex Mono 0.8125rem `--label` beside a hollow ring.

TO DO.
- Drop the time column wherever the time is not real (the demo's 19:56): the stack alone carries the date.
- 'Someday' becomes 'No date', set as the sentence-case label beside its ring.
- The quick add is unchanged. Neutral checkboxes as on Home.

STATUS.
- 'What it has cost' gets a 4:3 glass in the diary's slate case holding a moving-coil spend meter. The arc runs from $0 to 125% of the limit, with major ticks at the quarters, the overrun hatched past a lit limit tick, and a ghost needle at the 30-day average day ('Average day $0.04' in dim phosphor). The live needle has a hot core in an 8px halo and kicks 17 degrees as the glass warms, then settles.
- '$0.00 of $2.00 today' is written in VT323 above the arc and said again in words beside it, because the SVG is aria-hidden.
- The meter is the page's one focal plate.
- The head tally stays ('5 working · 7 off'), but '1 needs a look' is set in `--ink` with one small amber ring and stays a link. Amber words are only for what an admin must act on.
- 'Who answers' is a chain on the page's own line: the 2px steel sub-rail through the lamps for chat, digest, lookups and the fallback, lit 2px brand with a soft glow only between two consecutive lamps that are on, so it visibly breaks at the fallback.
- Lamps are rings, matching the spine. The key 'What the marks mean' explains the rings, the filled Now lamp, the amber ring and the lit chain, and it appears only on Status and Settings.

SETTINGS. Unbox the index's tiles into rows on the spine: a ring, the section name in Instrument Sans 600 1.125rem, its state in `--ink-2` and a chevron. 'Needs a look' comes first. The sections' groups stay unboxed as in Kept.

THE FORM (new idea) and General: fields are `--field` wells with a 1px `--edge` edge. The field being typed in lights its edge (E4). The Save key is lit from within (E3 ring and a pool under it). Group heads hang from the line at rings.

PHONE (390).
- Top bar: the mark plus the 'FamilyDB' wordmark at left, and one 44px 'More' menu at right holding Memory, Family, Status and Settings. No four labelled icons. The bottom tab bar stays (Home first).
- Box: a two-line placeholder; From, the mic and Send on one row; 'Send where I am' under them.
- The three starters stack as full-width 44px rows, with no sideways scroll.
- The title is set at 2rem so 'What can we pencil in?' breaks after 'we' at worst.
- The diary stack sits over the title in To do and Plans rows, so titles stop wrapping.
- The spine stays solid to Later.

TYPE STEPS: h1 2.5rem, title 2.75rem, h2 1.375rem, shelf head 1.25rem, body 1rem/1.5, meta at least 0.8125rem (raised from 0.75rem). Figures are Plex Mono tabular, or Plex Sans Light tabular for the diary figure. Mono caps appear nowhere outside the glass. Three faces plus VT323 on the glass.
briefs.borrows:
From the OTHER camp (main):

(1) **Moving-coil spend meter with a ghost average needle, and the tube warming up from a line.** Source: Desk Terminal, Joined (r13-idea-1).
- Files: /tmp/claude-0/-home-user-FamilyDB/62374e35-c7e3-5c25-a94d-0502bde8e9d6/scratchpad/harness/cross/x14a-a/variants/r13-idea-1/templates/_ui.html (macro spend_meter, lines ~229-255), templates/status.html (lines ~53-69, the call with the average and the limit).
- Styles: /tmp/claude-0/-home-user-FamilyDB/62374e35-c7e3-5c25-a94d-0502bde8e9d6/scratchpad/harness/cross/x14a-a/variants/r13-idea-1/sheet.css (.needle-core/.needle-halo/.needle-tip/.needle-ghost/.needle and @keyframes swing, lines 3095-3100; .crt.power-on, line 1220-1222; @keyframes power-on, line 2074; .crt-tube > .pic warm-up, line 2438), and palette.css lines 826-830.
- Rebuilt in the diary's slate case on Status. The warm-up runs on Home's Next tube and the Plans month glass.
- Judges' praise: soul 8.8 'the most period-true lit instrument on any page'; skeptic 'real light as data'.

(2) **Setup folded to one line naming the next step** (ledger L270). Source: Quote Board at Evening (r13-mut-3).
- Files: /tmp/claude-0/-home-user-FamilyDB/62374e35-c7e3-5c25-a94d-0502bde8e9d6/scratchpad/harness/cross/x14a-a/variants/r13-mut-3/templates/home.html (lines 126-140: section.alert.setup, .alert-figure, .alert-one, details.rest), sheet.css .alert and its children (lines 1173-1189).
- Rebuilt as an amber-ringed stop on the spine between Now and Next. The figure is in bone, not amber (soul's warning on t3-timetable-graft's loud amber 3). It takes the ledger's middle way: the first step as the link, the others as run-in words.

(3) **The row afterglow that shows** (L228). Also from Quote Board at Evening (r13-mut-3).
- Files: /tmp/claude-0/-home-user-FamilyDB/62374e35-c7e3-5c25-a94d-0502bde8e9d6/scratchpad/harness/cross/x14a-a/variants/r13-mut-3/sheet.css (--row-wash line 72, --afterglow line 92; .tape > li:hover line 1271, .idea-rows > li.card:hover line 1468, .task:hover line 1620, .section-card:hover line 1737).
- Applied to every diary row with a sage edge, and on :has(:focus-visible) too.
- It answers soul's and system's standing fix that this line's afterglow is invisible.

(4) **Chain lit only between lamps that are on** (L259). Source: Evening Listing, Traced (r12-idea-1).
- Files: /tmp/claude-0/-home-user-FamilyDB/62374e35-c7e3-5c25-a94d-0502bde8e9d6/scratchpad/harness/cross/x14a-b/variants/r12-idea-1/palette.css (lines 714-722, '.chain' and the lit-segment rules), templates/status.html (lines 65-69, `lines(models, 'chain')`).
- Rebuilt as a sub-rail of the diary's own steel line, with the ring lamps, on Status's Who answers only, since that is the only real chain.

FROM THE LEDGER: **L233 'Arrived' afterglow on her newest reply**, from r10-mut-5 Signal Legend Relit.
- Source: /tmp/claude-0/-home-user-FamilyDB/62374e35-c7e3-5c25-a94d-0502bde8e9d6/scratchpad/harness/rounds/r10/palettes/r10-mut-5.json, the RELIT css block: .said-bot:target>.bubble animation arrived 1.8s, and the last bubble's steady edge.
- Steady bloom on the newest line only, per the system judge's caveat.

FROM ITS OWN LINEAGE: t3-pocket-mut's rule that what the machine says glows and the family's words stay matte (/tmp/claude-0/-home-user-FamilyDB/62374e35-c7e3-5c25-a94d-0502bde8e9d6/scratchpad/harness/tour/t3-a/variants/t3-pocket-mut/), with the type judge's weaker halo (0 0 6px at 25%) and without the false caret (soul, type, usability).

ITS OWN JUDGES' FIXES, most cited first:
- Spine faint, nodes fussy: one ring style, heavier steel, lit Now and Next lamps, labels as words (feedback, soul, style, system, skeptic on the landing panel; skeptic t3).
- The Now/Next/Later/Someday plates as tracked mono pills: set in Instrument Sans 600 sentence case, at least 13px (type t2 and t3, skeptic t3, usability landing, style t3-carried).
- Setup column too heavy: one line (skeptic t3, interaction t3, feedback landing).
- Right column empty below the wishes, and the dotted Later tail: the shelf gets To do first plus leaves, and the line ends at its last row (system t3, skeptic landing).
- Tube pushes Coming up below the fold: tube capped at 216px with the trace inside (interaction t3, feedback landing).
- Grounded fills: slate day tabs, shelf leaves, kind wells, slate family slips (feedback landing, system t3).
- Amber checkboxes read as warnings: neutral boxes, amber on the ring and the words (skeptic landing, system t3).
- Drop the '2 Oct Fri' stamp over the greeting (soul, type).
- Light 'plan' with the full halo: here 'pencil' (soul).
- Raise the meta floor one step (type).
- Phone bar shows secondary pages: mark plus More (system, interaction landing).
- Phone box tall, starters sideways: two-line box, stacked starters (usability t3, interaction t3).
- Month days at least 32px and jump links (usability t2 and t3).
- Explain the ring node and give Status a focal plate (system, interaction, usability).
- 'No date', not 'Someday' (usability).
- 'who' in a fixed column (type t3).
- Drop the meaningless 19:56 (type t3).
- Key only on Status and Settings (feedback, skeptic t2).
- Unbox the Settings index (system t3).

One fix is declined, with its reason: interaction's 'set dates on one line, Sun 27 Sep'. The diary stack is the line's identity, praised by every other lens.
briefs.avoids: Faint, fussy spine: one 2px weight, rings only, words for labels, lit lamps at Now and Next. Costume tracked mono pills: gone. Dark void and an empty right column: slate day tabs, shelf leaves, To do rising into the freed shelf, and the line ending at its last row. A heavy setup list: one line on the spine. A tube that costs a screen: capped at 216px. Amber as warning: neutral checkboxes, a bone setup figure, an ink 'needs a look'. 'Changes little in phosphor terms': a lit Now lamp, a halo on the lit word, the warm-up, the needle, the lit chain and Vera's lit lines. Light spreading or glare: the steady bloom stays on the newest line only, afterglow edges are sage, and the family's words stay matte. Small meta text: raised floor. Phone: labelled secondary icons replaced by More, starters stacked, a shorter box. Also avoids the other camp's faults it borrows from: no boxed equal-weight cards (Desk's 'dashboard'), no mono 'was due' (Desk's type fault), no tracked caps legends (Quote's), and the needle has a ghost and a lit limit tick so a still at $0.00 does not read dead. Gives up to make room: the square nodes, the plate pills, the stamp over the greeting, the full setup column, the dotted Later tail, the four-week strip below the tube, and Status's big '$0.00' glass (its figure moves above the meter).
briefs.title: What can we *pencil* in? ('pencil' lit). This has not been tried. It is the pocket diary's own verb for planning: you pencil a weekend, an appointment, a reminder or an idea into a diary. So it names FamilyDB's job across plans, reminders and kept ideas in the lineage's own world. It asks the family to tell Vera something, and it cannot be answered with a bare 'no' the way 'Anything to plan?' was. The lit word is a single 6-letter word with a compact halo. 'can we' keeps it the household's question without the stiffness judges found in 'shall'. If the judges find it twee, the lineage's best tried title, 'What's our plan?', is the fallback.
